data.body: Landing update: the initial patchset fixed the Anthropic lazy-import/test-double defect, but PS1 CI exposed a nested-pytest `.pytest_cache` leak. Adding `-p no:cacheprovider` was proven by exact mutation (removing it recreated one pass plus a root-leak teardown error) and fixed that secondary test-harness defect. PS2 then encountered the unrelated chronic missing-blob fixture failure; that class was independently fixed and landed in Change 1857. Change 1855 was rebased onto 1af71dda575ca02c8a726a0ff63867ebf28f4189 and repushed as PS3. Run 32137022497 passed in 1813 seconds with no retries: Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13 all green; Python 3.12 reported 13,835 passed / 64 skipped, the Anthropic isolation oracle passed, and the authorship fixture passed. Gerrit had LLM-Review+1, Verified+1, zero unresolved comments, and Change 1855 merged as eca9735365b98af6fdd65d93c67fb45b6eaed50f.
